name: Intuigence AI
description: Synthetic AI engineers for Industrial Operations that help users automate routine tasks so human engineers can bring their ingenuity to creative and complex challenges.Its industrial semantics, ontologies, physics aware models and purpose built agents supply the understanding that turns raw data into  industrial grade operational intelligence using RTI on Fabric as the backbone. Eventstreams capture and transform data at massive scale, eventhouse delivers fast and flexible analytics and OneLake ensures that context is unified and discoverable.
